method: Execute the canonical migration and generated parts in two independent PGlite instances using the existing schema fixture; compare complete catalogues, functions, triggers, RLS, policies, privileges and columns.
limitations: The TAP result was observed in the local execution output; this file is a summary, not a reconstructed TAP log.
Each part has its own transaction; there is no transaction spanning all calls.
An empty plans table does not prove the target is an isolated Supabase branch.
Verify target project_ref and complete catalogue values before connecting synthetic clients.
No real Auth, PostgREST or hosted concurrency was tested.
